messages.subject: Re: Server Problem with Shiny
parts:
Marieta,

You need to create a directory called "www" in the same directory as your server.R and ui.R. Move your css and html files to that directory.
In your ui.R where you refer to those files, you do not need to add "www" to the path; just use the filename.

Fereshteh

messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Re: Server Problem with Shiny
parts:
If you run rsconnect::showLogs() from the same computer and RStudio project where you deployed the app from, you should be able to see some log info.
http://shiny.rstudio.com/articles/shinyapps.html#application-logging

If that doesn't work for you, can you log into shinyapps.io in your web browser, find the application in question, click on its Settings, then find the Logs section? That should show what errors happened on the R side, if any.

By the way, what's your intention with that HTML file? It looks suspicious. Do you intend for it to be a static table, or to display dynamic output from the server?
